query: The Church of the Guanche People was founded in the city that is on the most populated island of what larger area?

pipeline_result.response: The Church of the Guanche People was founded in the city that is on the most populated island of Tenerife, Spain.
retrieved_context: Tenerife: Tenerife ( ; ] ) is the largest and most populated island of the seven Canary Islands.  It is also the most populated island of Spain, with a land area of 2034.38 km2 and 898,680 inhabitants, 43 percent of the total population of the Canary Islands.  Tenerife is the largest and most populous island of Macaronesia.

Church of the Guanche People: The Church of the Guanche People (Spanish: "Iglesia del Pueblo Guanche" ) is a religious organisation, founded in 2001 in the city of San Cristóbal de La Laguna (Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain).  It aims to perpetuate and spread the pagan religion of the ancient Guanche people.
